lines.en: Sssss, Demon Slayer Corps, die!
Aaah, prey here!
Eat them, Blood Sorcery!
Avoid the sun, Demon Slayer!
Hahahaha, yummy flesh!
Chase, chase, chase!
Ice breath, freeze them!

lines.zh: 咬住他们，撕开他们的喉咙！
lines.en: Bite them, rip their throats!

lines.zh: 黑暗里我伸长舌头，先尝到你的位置。
lines.en: In the dark my long tongue tastes where you are.
The sky is still dark; I walk along the eaves.

lines.zh: 舌头拖在地上，黏出一条路。
lines.en: My tongue drags on the ground, leaving a wet path.

lines.zh: 天还黑，我要多走几条街。
lines.en: The sky is still dark; I will walk a few more streets.
Lick tongue, feel the night breeze.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的家园，我的领地！
lines.en: Darkness is my home, my territory.
Stare, wait for prey.
Lick lips, ready to attack!
Wait for Demon Slayer Corps' mistake!

lines.zh: 静静等待，猎物自投罗网！
lines.en: Silent wait, prey falls into trap.
Ice附身, stare at enemy!
Stare until prey trembles!
Silent wait, prey appears.
Wait, wait, wait!

lines.zh: 长舌头，已经舔到你背后。
lines.en: My long tongue has reached your back.
Prey found, attack!

lines.zh: 感受到你的气息，鬼杀队！
lines.en: Sense your scent, Demon Slayer Corps!

lines.zh: 长舌探出去，先尝你的位置。
lines.en: My long tongue reaches out and tastes where you stand.
My tongue is longer than my arm.
Lock onto Demon Slayer Corps!
Sense your presence, Demon Slayer Corps!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的队服，在夜里很显眼。
lines.en: The Demon Slayer uniform stands out in the night.
Demon Slayer Corps' scent, very strong!
Target locked, act!
Ouch, my tongue is hurt!
Ow! My tongue got chopped off!
Ouch! My tongue is bitten!

lines.zh: 嘶～我的舌头沾到鬼火了！
lines.en: Ouch! My tongue is burned by ghost fire!

lines.zh: 啊！我的舌头被箭射中了！
lines.en: Ow! My tongue is hit by an arrow!
Ouch! My tongue is hit by lightning!

lines.zh: 嘶～我的舌头被饥饿咬伤了！
lines.en: Ouch! My tongue is starved!
Ouch! My tongue is broken!

lines.zh: 嘶～我的舌头被阳光晒伤了！
lines.en: Ouch! My tongue is sunburned!
Ouch! My tongue is trapped!
The blood on you is too sweet!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我用长舌舔一舔！
lines.en: Come, let me taste with my long tongue!
Your flesh is delicious!

lines.zh: 你的鲜血会让我更加强大！
lines.en: Your blood will make me stronger!
Enjoy my blood magic!
Come, let me devour you!
Your flesh will nourish me!
My long tongue will snatch you away!

lines.zh: 我的舌头比你的刀还长。
lines.en: My tongue is longer than your blade.
Surrender and enjoy my gift!
Watch out for my long tongue!
My long tongue lashes out and wraps you.
My tongue is faster than you!
You stepped on my tongue tip — back off.

lines.zh: 我的舌苔已经记住了你。
lines.en: The coating on my tongue has memorized you.

lines.zh: 你的剑对我来说太慢了！
lines.en: Your sword is too slow for me!

lines.zh: 我的长舌头，比你的剑还长。
lines.en: My long tongue is longer than your sword.

lines.zh: 我的长舌可以绕过一切！
lines.en: My long tongue can bypass everything!
One long tongue out, do not come closer.
My long tongue will hit you!

lines.zh: 舌头上，全是血鬼的味道。
lines.en: My tongue carries the taste of demon blood.
I'll protect you!
Let's move together!
Come, let me guide you!

lines.zh: 你也是饮血才站起来的吗？
lines.en: Did you too rise only after drinking blood?
My strength is enough to protect you!
Follow me, I'll lead the way!
Share this land with me!
Follow me!
I'll be your best companion!

lines.zh: 长舌缠绕，腐肉散发恶臭。
lines.en: Long tongue wraps, foul flesh stinks.

lines.zh: 阴风拂过，我的舌头滴血。
lines.en: Cold wind passes, my tongue drips blood.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，黑暗中舞蹈。
lines.en: Dance with your soul in the dark.
Ghostly flames flicker, do you smell it?

lines.zh: 黑暗是我们的归宿，腐烂是我们的食粮。
lines.en: Darkness is our home, decay is our food.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的勇气，我将你囚禁。
lines.en: Consume your courage, I imprison you.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，你们离死亡不远了。
lines.en: Sunset, Sunbeams, you are close to death.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？腐烂的味道。
lines.en: Do you smell it? The scent of decay.

lines.zh: 我的舌头，将你带入深渊。
lines.en: My tongue will drag you into the abyss.
You cannot escape, my tongue.

lines.zh: 猎物，我的舌头要品尝你。
lines.en: Prey, my tongue desires you.

lines.zh: 感受我的诅咒，你颤抖吧。
lines.en: Feel my curse, tremble.
Ghostly flames guide, you will be consumed.
Draw near, you will be dust.

lines.zh: 你的血肉，滋养我的灵魂。
lines.en: Your flesh feeds my soul.
My tongue will tear you apart.
Sunset, Sunbeams, I am the reaper.

lines.zh: 你无法逃离，我的舌头在后。
lines.en: You cannot escape, my tongue is behind you.

lines.zh: 感受绝望，我的舌头在你耳旁。
lines.en: Feel despair, my tongue at your ear.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，滋养我的力量。
lines.en: Your fear feeds my power.
My long tongue has tasted your scent.
Demon Slayer uniform: the blood smells best.
My tongue is longer than your blade.

lines.zh: 你站在月光下，太显眼了。
lines.en: Standing in the moonlight, you are too visible.
You are tonight's midnight snack.

lines.zh: 我不用转身，舌头绕着树来。
lines.en: I need not turn; my tongue comes around the tree.

lines.zh: 感受我的触感，你颤抖吧。
lines.en: Feel my touch, tremble.

lines.zh: 舌头舔过你的锁骨，凉得很。
lines.en: My tongue licks across your collarbone, cold.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的刀，砍不穿我这层皮。
lines.en: Demon Slayer blades cannot cut through this hide.

lines.zh: 感受我的力量，你无法逃脱。
lines.en: Feel my power, you cannot escape.
My tongue will consume you.

lines.zh: 你的挣扎，无法改变命运。
lines.en: Your struggle cannot change your fate.

lines.zh: 我的诅咒顺着舌头爬进你耳朵。
lines.en: My curse crawls through my tongue into your ear.

lines.zh: 鬼火在我舌下烧，闻起来是甜的。
lines.en: Demon fire burns under my tongue; it smells sweet.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，我一口一口舔干净。
lines.en: I lick up your fear bite by bite.

lines.zh: 舌头卷起来，先试试距离。
lines.en: My tongue curls up to test the distance.

lines.zh: 血鬼术在舌尖凝成一滴。
lines.en: Blood Demon Art gathers in a drop at my tongue's tip.

lines.zh: 我的护甲硬，你的刀会滑。
lines.en: My hide is hard; your blade will slide.

lines.zh: 别站在阴影外，我等光退。
lines.en: Do not stand out of the shade; I wait for the light to fade.
You go left; my tongue goes right.

lines.zh: 四十点血，够我玩一会儿。
lines.en: Forty points of health: enough to play a while.

lines.zh: 舌尖已经贴上你的后颈。
lines.en: My tongue's tip is already on your nape.
I need not run; my tongue is fast enough.

lines.zh: 你数着脚步，我数着呼吸。
lines.en: You count footsteps; I count breaths.

lines.zh: 长舌头垂着，我先舔一下。
lines.en: My long tongue hangs; let me taste.
Long tongue licks you!
Long tongue surprises you!
Bite you to taste!
Spit blood out!
Spit blood to harass!
Tongue wraps you!
Tongue licks your skin!
Tongue venom bites you!
Long tongue bites your life!
Sharp tongue is unstoppable!

lines.zh: 舌头抽在你脸上，火辣辣的！
lines.en: My tongue lashes your face, stinging hot!
I coil your ankle and drag you in!
My tongue tip jabs into your armor's seam!

lines.zh: 缠上你的脖子，越勒越紧！
lines.en: I wrap your neck, tightening with every turn!

lines.zh: 血鬼术顺着舌头喷出来！
lines.en: Blood Demon Art sprays out along my tongue!
One flick throws you against the wall!

lines.zh: 咬一口，尝尝鬼杀队的血！
lines.en: One bite to taste Demon Slayer blood!

lines.zh: 伸出三米，你躲不过三米！
lines.en: I reach three meters; you cannot dodge three meters!
I appear at night!
Rise in the darkness!
Watch out, Ghostslayers!
Stronger under moonlight!
Active at night!
Hide in shadows!

lines.zh: 夜色一沉，我的长舌先伸出来。
lines.en: As night deepens, my long tongue comes out first.
Lurk in the dark!
I appear only at night!

lines.zh: 太阳落下，我的舌头就伸出来。
lines.en: The sun sets, and my tongue unrolls.

lines.zh: 巷子尽头，舌头先探出来。
lines.en: At the alley's end, my tongue comes out first.

lines.zh: 我贴着屋檐走，避开月光。
lines.en: I walk along the eaves, avoiding moonlight.

lines.zh: 夜风里，血鬼术的味道散开。
lines.en: On the night wind, the smell of Blood Demon Art spreads.

lines.zh: 我蹲在井边，等天彻底黑。
lines.en: I crouch by the well, waiting for full dark.
Fire scorches my tongue and it snaps back!

lines.zh: 从屋檐摔下来，护甲磕响了！
lines.en: I fall from the eaves and my hide clatters!

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，舌头都沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and my tongue sinks.
The blast ties my tongue in knots!

lines.zh: 箭钉在护甲上，拔不出来！
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hide and will not come out!

lines.zh: 术法压过来，血鬼术被压住了。
lines.en: Spell pressure bears down and my Blood Demon Art is smothered.
I am so hungry my tongue trembles.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，牙都在响！
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my teeth rattle!

lines.zh: 坠进黑暗，舌头也舔不到边。
lines.en: I fall into darkness, and my tongue finds no edge.
